newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe said busy with diamond exploration.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe said busy with diamond exploration.

text.p: Most mineral exploration taking place in Zimbabwe was concentrated on the search for diamonds, the country's Chamber of Mines told Reuters.
"The amount of exploration going on here is enormous and across the board but mostly for diamonds," Chamber chief executive Derek Bain said.
Zimbabwe had one diamond mine in production -- Auridian River Ranch -- but many junior mining companies from Australia and Canada were involved in exploration, he said.
South African diamond giant De Beers was present in the country, but as yet only involved in exploration.
Auridian, located near Zimbabwe's southern border, produced about 500,000 carats per annum, Bain said.
He said that a "fair amount" of gold exploration was occurring as well.
